decay.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of Pacific yew: flat, sharp-pointed needles 1 to 2.5 cm long, about 2 mm wide, yellow-brown when shed; no cones (the seeds sit in red arils that animals take). Colours chosen by eye; twig numbers plausible, not measured.

foliage.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of Pacific yew: flat, sharp-pointed needles 1 to 2.5 cm long, about 2 mm wide, yellow-brown when shed; no cones (the seeds sit in red arils that animals take). Colours chosen by eye; twig numbers plausible, not measured. The dry colours were moved 0.3 of the way to their own grey on 2026-10-18, beside a photograph of a conifer floor the owner supplied: weathered needles bleach to a grey tan.

look.note: Authored: the drawn look's mean hue at the brightness chosen by eye for this species' litter, the relief the drawing has, and a tile its pieces repeat on unseen. PlantGen's litter tests check the hue and relief against the drawing. The brightness was raised 1.7 times on 2026-10-18, beside a photograph of a conifer floor the owner supplied, on which the litter in Project After read far darker than real duff.
